verdict.rationale: CSC documents a dedicated service-of-process pipeline: same-day secure scanning and delivery of SOP, a dedicated U.S.-based Litigation Management Team, OCR, time-stamping, and routing to designated contacts. Nothing in the evidence describes how ordinary mail is handled, so the separation from ordinary mail and any difference in delivery commitments is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation contrasting SOP handling with ordinary mail, documented delivery commitments for ordinary mail to compare against, independent or hands-on corroboration of the same-day SOP commitment.
